reviews.comment: She was a great professor who was always willing to help if you were confused on any of the essays. Gives great feedback essays and projects weren't too difficult. Lecture was very informative and mandatory as there are in class work, though never hard. She does have problem pacing the lecture and sometimes have to push assignments back. Super nice
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Caring

reviews.comment: She's very nice and relaxed. Sometimes got stressed because there is alot of assignments, but she gives good critiques and is accessible outside of class. Pretty lenient over attendance and I didn't think she was a tough grader.
reviews.ratingTags: So many papers--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Avoid. She loves the honor council when you accidentally have a slip up she doesn't help you with. Will drive your GPA into the floor.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. Pattison is a REALLY nice person. She is very sweet and understanding. Although I did not love the structure of the class (I actually hated most of the books) she was incredibly lenient in grading your papers and projects. There is a lot to do for this class and I didn't love how attendance was mandatory but she made class fun. Youll do fine.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Pattison uses a contract grading scale, but the syllabus always made this information clear and accessible. She always answered questions about it clearly. It seems like a lot of reading, but hey, it's an English class. If you read and keep up with what's needed, you'll do fine. She's very kind and the readings and class discussions were fun.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Very complicated grading structure, she wants you to complete X, Y,  and Z in order to get an A. If you do excellent on X and Y but fall behind on Z, you're not allowed to get an A by her grading structure. She's a good person but all of the assignments are busy work and I have not learned anything about literature.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I am only doing this review because I feel like the reviews make her out to seem worse than she is. She actually is genuinely a nice professor, she is willing to help in any way and even offers extra credit. There are a lot of assignments but are graded fairly easy. The grading structure is also strange, but it isn't difficult to maintain an A.

Professor Pattison is such a sweet woman, but her class taught me absolutely nothing. We did so much busy work and read so many novels that were mediocre at best. The grading scale was confusing and unclear. Overall, the class felt like a waste of time, which was disappointing because I was excited to take it.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: this grading scale is the dumbest thing I have ever experienced in my life. I am an English Major and this simply makes no sense whatsoever. I have no idea why a professor would ever set up a class like this. It's not a hard class, the books are fine, but honestly, the grading is just so ridiculously frustrating.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I rarely leave a review for an in-progress class, but man this one's rough at times. I like the books and the subject, but it's just so much time-consuming work. 15+ (short) papers, 2-3 projects, and 100+ pgs of reading/night. She's sweet but seemingly oblivious to the fact that we can't commit every waking hour to her class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I am currently taking this course and am just here to fulfill a comm credit. This class is ridiculous. I like to read but the books she has chosen are terrible, along with a paper being due before each class. The organization is so bad and everyone is confused. She also calls on people during class... like we are in high school. DON'T TAKE HER.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: She's a good person but expects way too much out of you whereas assignments are busy work and so directed to carrying out simple tasks and comprehension way more than necessary. I'm good at writing but I think its kind of a joke that she requires attendance and docks of points but whatever. I wouldn't take her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: DON'T TAKE!! There's a reading assignment and paper due before each class. You have to make some sort of argument about the reading, which I found difficult to do and she doesn't teach you how to become any better doing so. Didn't learn anything about literature, so I waste money on a course to gain zero literature skills. Grading scale SUCKS!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: AVOID. A paper is due before every class over 100+ page reading assignments. I'm talking up to 2+ hours of just reading. There is constantly some paper, project, reading, etc. that it's nearly impossible to focus on other classes. You'll be burnt out  within the first few weeks. Sweet lady, but she expects way too much. You don't learn anything!!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: One of the most caring and understanding professors I have taken. If you do not like to read, do not take this course. There are a lot of assignments, but if you have good time management there should be no issues. I truly enjoyed this course!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Caring

reviews.comment: I truly loved Dr. Pattison's course. She is so sweet and the workload is doable. Her rubric is set up to where you only need to do a certain amount of assignments to get an A. Assignments vary from discussion board posts to very short essays. There are 2 major assignments per semester but they are super easy. Take her if you have the chance!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: You choose what grade you want in this class. She gives you 3 attempts for every assignment, but she is the toughest grader I have had in all 4 years. Like seriously, this prof needs to chill on how picky she is. I will say she is reasonable and understanding but man, her assignments are pointless and time-consuming and she is a tough grader.Warned
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Pattison grades a little difficultly, but is very understanding & a great prof. She let me submit my finals later bc of other finals, tried to help me figure out what to do when other teammates weren't helping, and answered emails very quickly. The class itself is a little time-consuming, team project is annoying, but pretty easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This course was a "choose your own grade" class. You make the requirements on the first day of class so go easy on yourselves, she is pretty reasonable but does require a pretty large amount of work. You read 8 novels, some are boring but some are interesting, I recommend this course if you need an easy English course.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Homework assignments are due every Monday, Wednesday, Friday. Huge group project that was pointless and didn't teach me anything. She barely grades any assignments within a timely manner. Currently have 20 assignments I've turned in that are ungraded.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Group projects

reviews.comment: Good professor- she is very caring. You will need to attend class to participate in in-class group assignments. Honestly I only actually read one of the books all the way through, but still got an A. Put some effort in, read as much as you can, and you should be ok.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Pattison was definitely the best english teacher I've ever had. Very engaging and tries to keep lectures short and concise. Rubrics are very clear and the workload isn't anything crazy. Put in effort and you'll get a good grade. She's a really kind person and does everything she can to make the class as best as it can be.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: For a reading intensive class the work load was very manageable. Discussion questions due before class and a few 1 page formal responses. Very easy workload. Would HIGHLY recommend her over anyone else teaching this course, her's was definitely the most manageable than the others. Very easy to get everything done on time
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Do not take any course from this professor. Her course organization is way too complicated, she makes the students do most of the teaching, and there is way too much busy work. I learned nothing in this course except how much I could dislike a professor. She is unprofessional and I genuinely feel like my time and effort in this class was wasted.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is not an easy online class. There is lots of busy work with at least one thing due each week. This class took up a lot more time then I wanted and required a lot more effort than other online classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: Way more work than you would expect from an online class. Usually have at least 3 assignments due every week and all are due at noon for some reason. Assignments usually aren't hard, but most require a lot of effort. Though she does give pretty good feedback on all assignments.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: The class wasn't hard apart from just busy work, but it took nearly the whole semester to get any major grades. I was looking forward to getting feedback on my resume and cover letter, but even though that was the first thing we turned in, it took two months to get back and there wasn't any helpful feedback.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This prof was by far the worst I've had a Texas A&M so far. She doesn't care about teaching or grading the hours upon hours of busy work she gives. We barely got one grade in before q drop and it was only because we begged her to her job. I learned nothing from this course and it was not an easy a at all.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Wasn't a bad teacher just gives lots of unnecessary assignments that won't help with your final product for each unit. She will help you if you go to her office. Taking an 8 AM with a boring professor will make you not want to go. She is awesome otherwise.

Dr. Pattison is a nice and very helpful professor. She assigns a lot of homework that isn't necessarily difficult, but is time consuming, so just make sure you keep up with all of the due dates. There are group projects so be prepared to be actively working in class, rather than sitting and listening to lectures.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Pretty much everyone got an A, just be prepared for lots of small assignments that will slip your mind. End of the semester comes with lots of group projects. Nothing in this class was hard, just time consuming and long. Even though it was only a 30 person class, I still don't think she knew our names. Roll is taken every lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Pattison is extremely helpful if put in the effort to contact her. She is very soft-spoken so sit towards the front. She also takes a while to put in grades. There is no final; you just have to give a presentation at the end over a project that you and a group have been working on. She grades somewhat justly and provides feedback.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: I would totally recommend Dr. Pattison for anyone who is doing ENGL 203. She is amazing and very caring about her students. She gives lots of homework, but if you do the work, its an easy A.
